content_only.characteristics: Raw chunk text without context. Performed best in V2.

source_aware.characteristics: Adds document title and PMC document identifier prefix.

metadata_aware.characteristics: Contains full section path, but injected long comma-separated topic tags and document ID boilerplate.

metadata_aware_v2.characteristics: Added constant specialty and role headers. Degraded passage retrieval by homogenizing chunk representations.

proposed_v3_contextual_representation.name: contextual_path_prefix
proposed_v3_contextual_representation.justification: Unlike metadata_aware, it strips the synthetic 'Topics: ...' keyword list that caused semantic dilution and homogenization across intra-document chunks. It tests clean hierarchical natural context without repetitive metadata tags.
